title: Losing the family home and selling it for his sisters
summary: The family place was mortgaged; Ory sold it and gave the money to his sisters.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Why'd you go out on this little bridge to home?

Well, we didn't have no other place. You mean this was a little place in town? On the plantation, on the plantation. Oh, I see. Yeah. You mean it was just a good place to get together. Yeah, you see, we had lost our place, you know, and my dad and mother took me home. And it had too much mortgage on it, and I couldn't get enough money to pay it off, so I sold it and gave the money to my sisters.
And my brother, he had left home. He was in business himself. He had a grocery boy, you know, across the river. So we decided to give the girls the money, and we went for ourselves.
